description: At least one source file is selected for import.
notes: The designer cannot start without a source file.

description: The selected local file still exists at its registered path.
notes: Missing files must be relocated or re-imported.

description: The application can open and read the selected file.
notes: Permission and file-lock failures should identify the affected path.

description: The file can be parsed as CSV without a structural read failure.
notes: This check does not validate field values.

description: The CSV contains a usable header row.
notes: Mappings cannot be created without source column names.

description: The header row does not contain blank column names.
notes: Display the affected column positions; do not scan row values.

description: The header row does not contain duplicate source column names.
notes: User must resolve ambiguity before final mapping/pre-validation.

description: The file encoding is detected and supported.
notes: Automatically use UTF-8/Windows-1252/Latin-1 when safe; otherwise report the encoding problem.

description: The file contains at least one data row after the header.
notes: Allow entry but exclude the empty file from staging by default.

description: The parent folder or filename can suggest a Salesforce object API name.
notes: A missing suggestion does not block entry; the user may select an object manually.

description: The filename may differ from the Salesforce object API name when the parent folder identifies the object.
notes: Supports split files such as Account/CMF Approved_1.csv.

description: Several source files may be associated with the same Salesforce object.
notes: Files can share mappings later in the designer.

description: The file size is recorded for display and later integrity comparison.
notes: File size does not block entry by itself.

description: The file modification timestamp is recorded for later change detection.
notes: A later change should request refresh/re-import rather than validate rows at entry.

description: Object permissions, fields, Record Types, picklists, and lookups are not validated during entry.
notes: These checks belong to mapping validation or full pre-validation.

description: Source row values are not validated during entry into Template Designer.
notes: Required values, formats, duplicates, Record Types, picklists, and references are deferred to pre-validation.
